content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Huntsville

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a four-year degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high-school diploma plus five years. Verify you meet these education and experience thresholds before enrolling. Huntsville's defense, aerospace, and technology sectors value PMP-credentialed leaders—confirm your qualifications align with PMI standards.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Attend all sessions from your Huntsville location on your schedule. You'll master PMI's framework, processes, and exam domains through interactive instruction. This formal education satisfies PMI's mandatory contact-hour requirement before you can sit for the exam.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After course completion, create your PMI account and submit your official PMP application. Document your project-management experience and education. Pay PMI's exam fee. Your application undergoes PMI's standard verification; most approvals process without audit, though some candidates are randomly selected for audit review.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy provides exam-preparation resources and guidance to reinforce what you've learned. Schedule your exam at a Pearson Vue testing center or take it online from home. Dedicate time to review, practice questions, and self-assessment. On exam day, bring required identification and arrive early.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After passing, you earn the PMP designation for three years. During your renewal cycle, earn professional development units (PDUs) through training, conferences, volunteering, or self-study. Before expiration, submit your renewal application and PDUs to PMI. Staying current keeps your credential active and marketable in Huntsville's competitive PM landscape.
